out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the hand washing sink closest to the 3vat sink and dish washer.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC PROVIDED HAND WASHING SOAP FOR THE HAND SINK CLOSEST TO THE 3VAT SINK AND DISH WASHER.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: 1DR prep top on frontline and 2DWR lowboy under the grill did not have thermometers provided inside of the units.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLEASE PROVIDE THERMOMETERS IN BOTH UNITS THAT DO NOT HAVE ONE BY NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION, IN 6 MONTHS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT FACILITY NEEDDS A BLEACH TEST KIT TO TEST THE CHEMICAL DISH MACHINE. PIC CONTACTED THE COMPANY IN WHICH THEY RECEIVE ALL THEIR CHEMICALS FROM AND WAS ABLE TO SUMBIT AN ORDER FOR A BLEACH TEST KIT. THE KIT WILL ARRIVE IN 2 DAYS.
